stem_md: 设 $\Omega$ 是由 $\sqrt{x^2+y^2}\leq z\leq\sqrt{1-x^2-y^2}$ 所确定的立体，则三重积分 $\iiint_\Omega f(y,z)dv$ 化为球面坐标为（ ）
analysis_md:
由
$$
\left\{\begin{array}{l}
x^2+y^2=z^2\\
x^2+y^2+z^2=1
\end{array}\right.
$$
知
$$
\left\{\begin{array}{l}
x^2+y^2=\frac{1}{2}\\
z=\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}
\end{array}\right.,\quad\text{则}\quad
\left\{\begin{array}{l}
0\leq\theta\leq2\pi\\
0\leq\varphi\leq\frac{\pi}{4}\\
0\leq r\leq1
\end{array}\right.,
$$
$$
\iiint_\Omega f(y,z)\,dv=\int_0^{2\pi}d\theta\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{4}}d\varphi\int_0^1f(r\sin\theta\sin\varphi,r\cos\varphi)r^2\sin\varphi\,dr
$$

设 $\Omega$ 是由 $\sqrt{x^2+y^2}\leq z\leq\sqrt{1-x^2-y^2}$ 所确定的立体，则三重积分 $\iiint_\Omega f(y,z)dv$ 化为球面坐标为（ ） $\int_0^{2\pi}d\theta\int_0^{\pi/4}d\varphi\int_0^1 f(r\sin\theta\sin\varphi,r\cos\varphi)r^2\sin\varphi\,dr$ $\int_0^{2\pi}d\theta\int_0^{\pi/2}d\varphi\int_0^1 f(r\sin\theta\sin\varphi,r\cos\varphi)r^2\sin\varphi\,dr$ $\int_0^{2\pi}d\theta\int_0^{\pi/4}d\varphi\int_0^1 f(y,z)r^2\sin\varphi\,dr$ $\int_0^{2\pi}d\theta\int_0^{\pi/4}d\varphi\int_0^{\sqrt2/2} f(r\sin\theta\sin\varphi,r\cos\varphi)r^2\sin\varphi\,dr$ 由
$$
\left\{\begin{array}{l}
x^2+y^2=z^2\\
x^2+y^2+z^2=1
\end{array}\right.
$$
知
$$
\left\{\begin{array}{l}
x^2+y^2=\frac{1}{2}\\
z=\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}
\end{array}\right.,\quad\text{则}\quad
\left\{\begin{array}{l}
0\leq\theta\leq2\pi\\
0\leq\varphi\leq\frac{\pi}{4}\\
0\leq r\leq1
\end{array}\right.,
$$
$$
\iiint_\Omega f(y,z)\,dv=\int_0^{2\pi}d\theta\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{4}}d\varphi\int_0^1f(r\sin\theta\sin\varphi,r\cos\varphi)r^2\sin\varphi\,dr
$$
